Priya (Product): Quick cross-team pulse for the quarterly milestone sweep — please reply with a 1-line: shipped | slipped (root cause) | next step + owner. Goal: compact status for the weekly.
Avi (Eng): Shipped: v2 batching perf tweak -> dedicated pools. Result: ~95% token latency drop for long sequences. Slipped: dynamic quantization rollout — blocked by kernel bug on A100. Next: eng-infra to validate kernel patch, target 03/28. Owner: Avi.
Jules (Eng): Shipped: canary for streaming function-calls to hosted API. Slipped: stable rollout of burst autoscaler — e2e tests flaky causing rollbacks. Next: triage flakes with eng-sre tomorrow AM. Owner: Jules.
Kai (Platform): Shipped: routing-policy config landed in console (per-tenant overrides). Slipped: private deploy images for k8s 1.27 due to third-party base image mismatch. Next: vendor PR + temporary fallback image. ETA vendor PR 03/30, fallback ready 03/24. Owner: Kai.
Sam (Design): Shipped: updated model-catalog onboarding screens and microcopy for defaults. Slipped: minor copy polish and i18n checks — will ship early next week. Next: sync with Priya for copy signoff. Owner: Sam.
Priya (Product): Thanks — can each owner drop any open CI/PR links so we can ping reviewers? Example: Avi — need @eng-ml review on kernel patch.
Avi (Eng): Sending patch now, pinging @Jules and @eng-ml. CR: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/4321 :eyes:
Jules (Eng): I can review tomorrow morning. Also we need product acceptance criteria for the autoscaler change — @Priya can you post a short list?
Priya (Product): Acceptance criteria (short): 1) <=10% regression on 95th latency; 2) automated canary rollback within 15m; 3) dashboards + alerts in place. I'll post a tiny doc in #docs by EOD.
Kai (Platform): Noted. If vendor PR misses 03/30 we proceed with fallback image. Will open a rollback plan doc.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for streaming function-calls kicked off at 2176543500 — status: success :white_check_mark:
Jules (Eng): Adding quick e2e checklist here to follow after flakes are fixed:
```
- run e2e on canary
- validate rollback path
- perf smoke test (95th)
```
Avi (Eng): Kernel patch CI: https://ci.redwood/jobs/patch-4321 — currently one failing test, bisect started.
Priya (Product): Great — I'll synthesize for the weekly update. If anything slips or ships, please ping here (or @me). :thumbsup:
